selection_scope: Two already-discussed accepted multi-move LLM proposals, chosen post hoc. Not a random or full-cohort causal estimate.
design: For every member move independently: same frozen joint/start.json, same exact complete LLM routing_order, same normalized/source inputs, only that one internal-node move. No chaining or best-of search.
accounting: All eight outcomes, including timeouts/invalid/native failures and non-improvements, retained. Post-hoc native evaluations are excluded from original live-feedback, live-budget, and policy-ranking counts.
comparison: Certifiable single-move layouts are compared with the frozen incumbent and full joint result using actual routed bbox area and actual QCA cell count. Equal-or-better on both area/cells is reported; failure is not a numerical zero. This diagnostic cannot prove global necessity of the group.

This coordinated 3-node contraction preserves fanin order and uses the reference routing priority that prioritizes high-detour edges first.
